name: Two-Swung Brothers

Traits.name: Who Swings?
Traits.text: While the brothers is not Incapacitated, at the start of each of its turns, the brothers argues with itself over whose turn it is to swing; roll a d6. On a 1-3 it must use Committed Haymaker for its first attack this turn, and on a 4-6 it must use Mistimed Backhand for its first attack this turn, but either way it makes its Multiattack as normal.

Traits.name: Aura of Authority
Traits.text: While in a 10-foot Emanation originating from the brothers, the brothers and its allies have Advantage on attack rolls and saving throws, provided the brothers doesn't have the Incapacitated condition.

Actions.name: Multiattack
Actions.text: The brothers makes three attacks, using Mistimed Backhand or Committed Haymaker in any combination.

Actions.name: Mistimed Backhand
Actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +8, reach 5 ft. 13 (2d8 + 4) Bludgeoning damage plus 7 (2d6) Psychic damage.

Actions.name: Committed Haymaker
Actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +8, reach 5 ft. 22 (4d8 + 4) Bludgeoning damage.

lore: Two brothers stitched into one hide by a bargain gone wrong, they hunt for a body apiece and a surgeon monstrous enough to split them — but neither will let the other win the knife first.
